text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The present I picked out this time is... 
the "Model Schoolgirl Outfit"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It is quite literally me! In other 
words... gifting my own casual clothes?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's what you'd think, right? But you 
see, this time, I'm planning to bring out 
a whole different charm of Bakushin 
O-chan!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Based on a British traditional style, with 
a pop of vivid plaid and playful glasses 
frames to add flair!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It gives a cool and edgy impression, but 
with Bakushin O-chan's signature pop 
energy, it becomes 'exemplary'! What do 
you think?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! Right, right, I see, I see! So 
basically—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For this exemplary Class Rep! 
Cool-sounding loanwords suit me best! 
That's what you mean, right!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's Flight-san for you! I'll come 
by your room later!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Cool and edgy! And... an electrifying, 
brioche-like tiger!
